description: AuthorizationFlow.java implements the payment authorization process for PayPal, handling validation, idempotency, persistence, and external provider interaction within the payment service. It manages creating and retrieving PaymentIntent and PaymentAuthorization entities, and encapsulates the authorization logic including success and error handling.

classes.name: AuthorizationFlow
classes.description: A service class that manages the payment authorization process, specifically for PayPal, including validation, idempotency checks, and persistence logic.

classes.name: AuthorizationFlow.AuthorizationOutcome
classes.description: A record encapsulating the result of the authorization process, including intent and authorization identifiers, status, and timing details.

methods.name: authorizePayPal
methods.description: Main method to authorize a payment via PayPal, handling creation, idempotent retrieval, and response encapsulation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the authorization attempt for required fields and correct data formats.

methods.name: fromExisting
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationOutcome object from existing PaymentIntent and PaymentAuthorization entities.

methods.name: fromNew
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationOutcome object from newly persisted PaymentIntent and PaymentAuthorization entities.
